page_title: SAL 2-2 ACM | Salernitana v AC Milan 22/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' Federico Fazio (Salernitana) commits a rough foul. Daniele Doveri stops the game and makes a call.
90+5' You can see a deep sadness in the eyes of Vincenzo Fiorillo (Salernitana) as he leaves the pitch after receiving a red card.

90+4' A sweet pass finds Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom left corner. Mike Maignan is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' 2 - 2 Goal! Olivier Giroud gets to the ball and heads it over the defence to Luka Jovic (AC Milan), who meets it nicely and fires in into the back of the net. 2:2.
89' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle. Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) commits a foul after dangerous play.
87' An accurate cross picks out Davide Calabria (AC Milan) in the centre of the box, but his header floats harmlessly high over the bar.
85' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) receives a pass, beats an opponent and tries a long-range shot. It's a weak effort towards the middle of the goal and Benoit Costil easily makes the save.
82' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the middle of the goal, but Benoit Costil is prepared to thwart his effort.
80' Flag goes up against Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
78' That's the end of the game for Loum Tchaouna, who is replaced by Jovane (Salernitana).
78' Filippo Inzaghi has decided to substitute Grigoris Kastanos and he is replaced by Agustin Martegani (Salernitana).
78' Substitution. Dylan Bronn (Salernitana) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Pasquale Mazzocchi walks off.
77' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) tries to take the opposition by surprise with a quick free kick into the box.
76' Jan-Carlo Simic (AC Milan) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Salernitana.
74' The game has begun to heat up. Norbert Gyomber (Salernitana) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
73' The corner kick from Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
71' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Salernitana) has tested the patience of referee Daniele Doveri and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
70' Stefano Pioli decides to make a substitution. Christian Pulisic will be replaced by Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan).
70' Substitution. Ismael Bennacer makes his way off the pitch and Luka Jovic (AC Milan) comes on as his replacement.
69' Salernitana take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
68' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Salernitana comes to nothing. Salernitana earn a corner.

68' That was a nice football moment. Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the roof of the net. Mike Maignan guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save! The referee blows his whistle, Salernitana are awarded a corner kick.
68' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
67' Rough tackle by Jan-Carlo Simic (AC Milan). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Salernitana are awarded the free kick.
66' Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Daniele Doveri blows for a foul.
65' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) comes onto the pitch because Fikayo Tomori simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.

63' 2 - 1 What a beautiful moment! Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the bottom right corner. Mike Maignan just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 2:1.
62' A substitution has been made. Lorenzo Pirola is replaced by Norbert Gyomber (Salernitana).

60' Great solo effort by Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) as he tricks his way through two defenders before firing a drive from just outside of the box towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper is ready and produces a stunning save.

59' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball goes out of play and Salernitana will have a goal kick.
58' AC Milan are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
54' Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Mike Maignan makes a save.
53' Benoit Costil (Salernitana) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
50' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball goes out of play and Salernitana will have a goal kick.
49' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
48' Boulaye Dia is being substituted because of an injury. Filippo Inzaghi sends Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) on the pitch.
47' Boulaye Dia (Salernitana) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
46' The resulting corner, taken by Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan), comes to nothing.
46' Stefano Pioli has made a change at the break. Jan-Carlo Simic (AC Milan) has come on in place of Simon Kjaer.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' Simon Kjaer (AC Milan) is able to continue to play.
45+2' Simon Kjaer (AC Milan) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

45+1' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) latches onto a pass and lets rip with a swerving shot from long range towards the bottom right corner. It's a difficult effort to deal with and Benoit Costil does well to punch it away.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Daniele Doveri had an easy-decision to make.

42' 1 - 1 Goal! Antonio Candreva sent a fine cross from the corner kick. The perfect pass found Federico Fazio (Salernitana) and his bullet header from around the penalty spot went straight into the left side of the goal. The score is 1:1.
42' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) is about to take a corner kick.
40' Lorenzo Pirola (Salernitana) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Daniele Doveri blows for a foul.
39' The ball is out of play and Salernitana manage to earn a corner.
39' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
38' Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Salernitana force their opponents to concede a corner.
38' AC Milan can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
35' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
35' This shall not pass! Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
33' Although Filippo Inzaghi (Salernitana) is just on the bench, Daniele Doveri has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
32' Great solo effort from Antonio Candreva (Salernitana)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort rose just over the bar.
30' The resulting set piece from Salernitana is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

29' Lorenzo Pirola (Salernitana) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. Salernitana will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
29' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
27' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) dribbles into the box, but Benoit Costil is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
23' Daniele Doveri has a clear sight and sees a foul from Lassana Coulibaly (Salernitana).
22' Simon Kjaer (AC Milan) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
20' AC Milan are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

17' 0 - 1 Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) is more aggressive than the defenders which allows him to finish a rebound with a header from inside the box. The score changes to 0:1 and Rafael Leao gets a place in the statistics with the assistance.
17' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by AC Milan, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
16' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. It's a free kick to AC Milan in a dangerous position.
16' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
12' Daniele Doveri couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) and blew his whistle.
10' AC Milan have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Salernitana.
9' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) got on the ball on the edge of the box and blazed a first-time shot well over the bar.
7' A quickly taken corner by Salernitana.

6' CHANCE! Boulaye Dia (Salernitana) goes very close! He gathers a cross inside the box and fires a low shot to the bottom right corner, but Mike Maignan produces an excellent save. It will be a corner kick for Salernitana.
6' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) collects a wonderful lead pass and creates some space to smash the ball goalwards from long range. His shot goes painfully close to the right post!
5' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
3' AC Milan quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

2' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play. AC Milan will have a chance to score from a corner.
2' The game is interrupted. Ismael Bennacer (AC Milan) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
1' The match has just started.
AC Milan will kick-off.
Daniele Doveri got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
